meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 把 Python 网站代码（Flask、Django、FastAPI）部署到 Azure App Service Linux。它会自动确保资源组、托管计划和站点已存在，设置启动命令，上传代码，并输出部署消息。部署后不会做任何健康测试。
howto.when: 当你说出“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等，或要求把 Python 代码部署到 App Service 时触发。

say.text: 把 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service。
say.note: 会创建或复用资源组、计划并上传代码。

say.text: 用 azure.yaml 部署 Django 项目到 App Service。
say.note: 存在 azure.yaml 时走 azd 部署。

say.text: 将 FastAPI 应用发布到 App Service。
say.note: 会把启动命令设为 uvicorn。

howto.what_en: Deploys Python web apps (Flask/Django/FastAPI) to Azure App Service Linux. Ensures a resource group, plan, and web app exist, sets the startup command, uploads the code, and prints a post-deploy message. No health check is run after deployment.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'Flask App Service', 'Django App Service', 'FastAPI App Service', or ask to deploy Python code to Azure App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service.
say_en.note: Creates or reuses resources and uploads code.

say_en.text: Deploy my Django project using azure.yaml.
say_en.note: Uses azd deployment when the file exists.

say_en.text: Publish my FastAPI app to App Service.
say_en.note: Sets uvicorn as the startup command.
